**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

The audit architecture in this Agreement is entirely one-directional in our favour:

- **§ 7.0 (Audit)** — IBM performs process audits at MSL's Work Centers and subcontractor facilities, on advance notice of scope and method.
- **§ 13.1 / 21.2 / 21.3** — IBM may audit and inspect consigned Products and IBM-owned tooling.
- **§ 24.1 (System Access)** — "IBM retains the right to audit."
- **Attachment 6 § 4.0 (Additional Audit Rights)** — IBM/MS may monitor, inspect and audit MSL software installation locations, during MSL's business hours.
- **Attachment 6, Appendix A § 4** — audit of MSL's and its Subsidiaries' books, records and facilities, 45 days' notice, independent auditor, non-contingent fee, cost on IBM/MS unless material discrepancies; frequency capped at semiannual absent a prior material discrepancy.
- **§ 16.14 (Records)** — mutual five-year record retention only; it grants no inspection or audit right.

No provision gives MSL any right to audit, inspect or verify IBM's premises, records, systems or usage, and nothing grants MSL access to our systems. Because no audit obligation binds us at all, there is no frequency, notice, cost-allocation or system-access exposure to correct, and the rule is satisfied at the preferred position. Consistent with the planner hint, the IBM-side audit rights are not redlined.
